# recruiter-eval-workspace-eval

> Node-only TypeScript eval harness that wraps @tangle-network/agent-eval. Operator-facing `pnpm eval` runner for scenarios + LLM-as-judge rubrics + statistical regression gates against a baseline scorecard. Composes with eval:scenarios / eval:judge-rubric / eval:regression base layers; emits scorecard.json into .evolve/ for the project-level dashboard. This is the family for any standalone eval bundle that needs to grade an agent under test (HTTP target or in-process function) and gate CI on regressions.

## Stack
- Family: agent-eval-harness-ts
- Layers: agent-eval:scenarios, agent-base:tangle, agent-base:secure, agent-eval:judge-rubric, agent-eval:regression

## Entry Points
- src/eval/runner.ts
- src/eval/cli.ts
- src/lib/tangle.ts

## Commands
- pnpm install
- pnpm eval
- pnpm eval:compare
- pnpm typecheck
- pnpm eval:gate baseline.json head.json

## Extension Points
- scenarios/
- judges/
- src/eval/scorecard.ts
- src/eval/scenario-loader.ts
- src/lib/tools/
- templates/
- src/lib/secure/
- src/eval/judges/rubric-runner.ts
- src/eval/regression/gate.ts
